aer.text: Tezzeret makes the Aether Spire his secret base, converting Rashmi's device into the Planar Bridge, powered by aether from the Aether Hub.

As renegade forces close in on the Aether Spire and Consulate blockades fail one by one, the renegades attack in three teams, but Dovin Baan disables the disruptor and Baral dispels Jace's illusions until Pia's gremlins disable the cannon.
Liliana tries to assassinate Tezzeret while Chandra destroys the Planar Bridge with a fireblast shielded by Gideon, and Tezzeret inserts its core into himself and planeswalks away.
